name: Postmark
description: Postmark is a transactional email provider laser-focused on deliverability and speed. Unlike platforms that mix transactional and marketing email on shared infrastructure, Postmark uses dedicated IP pools solely for transactional traffic, resulting in industry-leading inbox rates.

useCases.task: Send transactional emails with the highest possible deliverability
Send password reset and account notification emails
Track email opens and clicks with detailed analytics

setupSteps: Create a Server (each server has its own API token)
Go to the server's API Tokens tab
Verify your sending domain under Sender Signatures or Domains

rateLimits.limit: No documented hard rate limit; burst up to 300 messages/second on high-volume plans
rateLimits.notes: Postmark focuses on quality over quantity. Throughput scales with plan. The sandbox server has separate rate limits.
rateLimits.retryStrategy: Implement exponential backoff for 429 and 5xx responses; check X-Postmark-Rate-Limit-Limit header

codeExamples.title: Send a basic email
codeExamples.notes: Always include both HtmlBody and TextBody for best deliverability. The 'From' must be a verified sender signature.

codeExamples.title: Send with a template
codeExamples.notes: Templates are managed in the Postmark dashboard. Use TemplateAlias (not ID) for maintainability.

gotchas: Postmark separates 'transactional' and 'broadcast' (marketing) streams with different API endpoints and infrastructure. Using the outbound stream for marketing email violates their terms and can get your account suspended.
The free sandbox mode is separate from production — test emails go to a test inbox, not real recipients. Switch to your live Server API token for actual delivery.
Postmark is significantly more expensive than SendGrid/Resend at high volumes. It is optimized for deliverability, not price. Calculate your actual cost before committing.
Sender signatures must be individually verified (each from-address needs its own verification, unless you verify the full domain).

reliability.notes: Postmark is known for consistently fast delivery (median under 3 seconds) and high inbox rates. They publish detailed deliverability statistics publicly.

qualityJustification: Best deliverability in the industry with excellent TypeScript SDK and honest, transparent practices. Slightly more expensive and more complex setup than Resend. The strict separation of transactional/marketing streams is a feature, not a bug.
bestFor: Transactional email where deliverability is the #1 priority and cost-per-email is secondary
